description: A membership library that stores users, passwords, roles, claims and logins through EF Core and signs users in to the same app; it is not an OpenID Connect server.
The Identity services that manage user records and passwords (`UserManager<TUser>`) and check credentials, lockout and two-factor rules at sign-in (`SignInManager<TUser>`).
An EF Core `DbContext` base class that maps the Identity tables such as `AspNetUsers` and `AspNetRoles`.
An extension that maps JSON endpoints such as `/register`, `/login` and `/refresh`, issuing cookies or opaque bearer tokens that are not standard JWTs.
Identity's protection against password guessing, 5 failed attempts and 5 minutes by default, applied only when sign-in is called with `lockoutOnFailure: true`.
A per-user value that Identity changes after security-sensitive updates, so existing cookies are rejected at their next validation.
A WebAuthn/FIDO2 credential bound to the site's domain, supported by Identity in .NET 10 as a primary, passwordless sign-in factor.
